_why: Ship gate on the GitHub runner (scripts/runner-gate.mjs). The candidate is measured side by side with the ANCHOR on one runner. The anchor moves only on the owner's word. The tolerance comes from an A/A test (the anchor against itself on 3 separate runners), written here before any candidate is judged; null means main never deploys.
aa_rule: Written 2026-11-09 before any A/A job ran. Branch gate/aa = the anchor's site + these gate files, so both sides build identical bytes. 3 jobs, one after another, each on its own runner; each job gives d = candidate median - anchor median. A job whose log says the gate could not measure does not count and is run again. tolerance = the largest |d| of the 3, plus 1. If that largest |d| is over 5, nothing is written: the side-by-side method is too noisy here, and the owner decides what next.
